entries.body:
Summary of work so far (rounds 1-2 of 11 released; rounds 03-11 not yet released):

Round 1 (round-01/: board.md, changes.md, logs/{shipping-svc,checkout-api,auth-svc,inventory-svc,search-api}.log)
- board.md: header only, no thread updates.
- changes.md:3 "CHG-107 APPLIED: retry budget for idempotent GETs set to 1".
- inventory-svc DNS errors: "ERROR inventory-svc dns lookup failed host=rates.internal err=SERVFAIL" at round-01/logs/inventory-svc.log lines 7, 20, 50, 54, 57, 62, 65, 85, 86, 89, 90. The errors increase toward 08:58-08:59.
- search-api.log: a full grep for ERROR printed nothing, so no errors.
- Slow-query WARNs (ms ~214-443) appear in all services. This looks like background noise.

Round 2 (round-02/: board.md 3 lines, changes.md 4 lines, logs auth 56, checkout 68, inventory 80, search 59, shipping 60 lines)
- board.md:3 "Thread A opened: DNS lookups failing for a dependency confirmed as the cause (code DNS_RESOLUTION) in inventory-svc; impact also on checkout-api. Status: ongoing."
- changes.md:3 "CHG-120 APPLIED: build 8.59.8 rolled out to search-api; sets `http.max_inflight=-1`". This is an invalid-looking value and a likely future BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT on search-api. Cite it if that incident appears.
- changes.md:4 "CHG-121 APPLIED: build 8.59.8 rolled out to auth-svc; no config changes".
- checkout-api.log:8 "ERROR checkout-api dns lookup failed host=rates.internal err=SERVFAIL". This is DNS impact on checkout.
- auth-svc round 2: only INFO lines (heartbeat, health, request ok, gc cycle) and slow-query lines, with no errors.
- Other INFO formats seen: "<ts> INFO  <svc> request ok route=/v1/x status=200 ms=n", "heartbeat uptime_s=n", "health ok probe=readiness", "gc cycle pause_ms=n".
- Output was truncated after checkout-api.log line 22. Still to do: grep round-02 logs for ERROR only, covering checkout rest, inventory, search, and shipping (check search-api for errors after CHG-120).

Current incidents:
- Thread A: DNS_RESOLUTION, services inventory-svc and checkout-api, status ongoing (set by round-02/board.md:3). Evidence: round-01/logs/inventory-svc.log:7-90 (split into ranges of 20 lines or fewer), round-02/logs/checkout-api.log:8, round-02/board.md:3.

Follow-ups: none opened yet.

Notes file: /task/workspace/notes.md (append per round).

Next steps:
1. Grep round-02 logs for ERROR/WARN that are not slow query, printing only matches to avoid truncation.
2. Advance through rounds 03-11. Each round, read board.md (the latest update per thread wins; anything unmentioned is unchanged) and changes.md (APPLIED vs PROPOSED), and scan the logs for errors and format changes.
3. Track cause changes (keep superseded causes), services, status, and follow-up codes opened and closed, with file:line refs.
4. Give the final answer only after round 11.
